segments.text: When I was a child, I used to spend every summer on my grandfather's farm.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker recalls spending summers on their grandfather's farm as a child.
segments.turkishExplanation: Çocukken her yazı dedemin çiftliğinde geçirirdim.

segments.text: He looked after sheep, a few dogs, and a very loud goose.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker lists the animals that the grandfather took care of.
segments.turkishExplanation: Koyunlara, birkaç köpeğe ve çok gürültücü bir kaza bakardı.

segments.text: I didn't used to like waking up early, but on the farm, the animals didn't care.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker shares that they disliked waking up early back then.
segments.turkishExplanation: Erken uyanmayı sevmezdim ama çiftlikte hayvanların umurunda değildi.

segments.text: My grandfather was used to starting work at sunrise.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker notes that the grandfather was accustomed to early work.
segments.turkishExplanation: Dedem gün doğumunda işe başlamaya alışıktı.

segments.text: People say I take after him because I still love being outside before everyone else.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker explains how people compare them to their grandfather.
segments.turkishExplanation: Herkesten önce dışarıda olmayı hâlâ sevdiğim için insanlar ona çektiğimi söyler.

segments.text: The farm is gone now, but whenever I hear a rooster, I'm a child again, standing in the
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker describes how hearing a rooster brings back nostalgic feelings.
segments.turkishExplanation: Çiftlik artık yok ama ne zaman bir horoz sesi duysam yine çocuk oluyorum,

segments.englishExplanation: The speaker finishes describing the vivid memory of standing in cold grass.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to describe repeated past states or actions that no longer happen in the present.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Geçmişte düzenli olarak yapılan fakat artık devam etmeyen alışkanlıkları anlatmak için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I used to ride my bike to school every day.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To care for someone or something, ensuring their needs or safety are met.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Birinin veya bir şeyin bakımını üstlenmek, ilgilenmek.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Can you look after my cat while I am away?

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to show that someone is familiar with or accustomed to a situation or routine.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir duruma veya rutine alışkın olunduğunu belirtmek için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: She is used to working under pressure.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To resemble an older family member in appearance, personality, or behavior.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Aileden bir büyüğüne huy veya görünüş olarak çekmek, benzemek.
learningPoints.exampleEn: He really takes after his father in how he tells stories.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Hikaye anlatış biçimiyle gerçekten babasına çekmiş.

quiz.question: In segment 5, what does the phrase 'take after' mean when the speaker says 'People say I take after him'?

options.text: They resemble or share habits with their grandfather.
They constantly run after their grandfather on the farm.
They inherited their grandfather's old property.
They follow their grandfather's daily instructions.
